Offline TF2: a personal, offline-only TF2 mod with every item, crates,
tools, a fake Mann Co. Store and crafting. It doesn't touch your real TF2
inventory and can't join real TF2 servers.

You need on this PC
-------------------
- Steam, running and logged in
- Team Fortress 2, installed
- Source SDK Base 2013 Multiplayer, installed. It's free: find it in your
  Steam Library under Tools.

To play
-------
1. Unzip this folder anywhere you like, for example in Documents. Keep
   everything in it together.
2. Double-click "Play Offline TF2.bat".
3. Open the console (Options > Advanced > Enable developer console) and give
   yourself items, for example:  inv_give_all
4. Start a server from the main menu ("Create Server") and add bots with
   tf_bot_add.

OFFLINE_INVENTORY.md (open it in Notepad) lists every command.

Your items
----------
Your items are saved in mod_tf\cfg\offline_inventory.txt. To update to a newer
build, unzip it on top of this folder and let it replace the files; that keeps
your items.
